headline: The Cheapest AC Bill Is the Breakdown That Never Happens
summary: Chennai works its air conditioners hard: 40°C summers, coastal humidity, monsoon damp and voltage swings that punish compressors. An Airam AMC keeps yours ahead of all of it, with two scheduled services a year, priority booking when the heat peaks, and discounted repairs in between. Plans start from ₹1,199 per unit per year.

symptoms.title: Servicing only after breakdowns
symptoms.description: Reactive repairs almost always cost more than the scheduled visit that would have prevented them, and they tend to land in the hottest week of May.

symptoms.title: Cooling fades every summer
symptoms.description: Dust-choked coils lose capacity slowly, so by the first 40°C stretch your AC runs longer and cools less.

symptoms.title: Electricity bills creeping up
symptoms.description: A unit that has skipped its services draws noticeably more power to hold the same room temperature.

symptoms.title: No service history
symptoms.description: Without dated records, brand warranty claims and resale valuations are both harder to defend.

symptoms.title: You live near the coast
symptoms.description: Sea air corrodes condenser fins quickly, and unprotected units in coastal Chennai age well ahead of schedule.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Basic and Comprehensive?
faqs.answer: Basic, from ₹1,199 per unit per year, gives you two scheduled services, priority booking and discounted repairs. Comprehensive, from ₹1,999, adds gas top-up cover and no-charge replacement of minor parts such as capacitors and drain fittings. For units past their fifth summer, or homes near the coast, Comprehensive usually pays for itself.

faqs.question: When are the two services scheduled?
faqs.answer: The first lands before peak summer, typically February or March, so the unit enters the 40°C months with clean coils. The second follows the monsoon, clearing the damp, fungal growth and corrosion the rains leave behind. You can shift either visit to suit your calendar.

faqs.question: Does the AMC cover all AC brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our technicians service Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, O General, Mitsubishi Electric and Panasonic under the same plan terms. Mixed-brand homes are common in Chennai and need no special arrangement.

faqs.question: What does the gas top-up cover actually include?
faqs.answer: Comprehensive covers routine gas top-ups when pressure runs low, which is the most common gas complaint we see. If a leak needs repair or a full R32 recharge, we quote it upfront at your plan's discounted rate before any work begins. Basic members pay standard top-up rates, from ₹1,499, less their repair discount.

faqs.question: Can I put an older AC on an AMC?
faqs.answer: Yes, with one honest step first. We inspect the unit on the opening visit and note any pre-existing faults, so your cover starts from a known baseline. Older units are usually the ones that gain the most from scheduled care.
